responseScale.label: Not in place
responseScale.operationalMeaning: The capability is absent or is not recognised as required.

responseScale.label: Informal / reactive
responseScale.operationalMeaning: Some activity occurs, but it is informal, reactive or dependent on individual effort.

responseScale.label: Partly designed
responseScale.operationalMeaning: The capability has been partly designed, but important elements are incomplete or inconsistent.

responseScale.label: Implemented in key areas
responseScale.operationalMeaning: The capability operates in key areas, but coverage or consistency is not yet organisation-wide.

responseScale.label: Consistently operating
responseScale.operationalMeaning: The capability is defined, operating consistently and supported by evidence.

responseScale.label: Embedded and improving
responseScale.operationalMeaning: The capability is measured, governed and deliberately improved over time.

questions.prompt: A named senior owner is accountable for fraud risk management and has authority to drive action.
questions.controlObjective: A named senior owner is accountable for fraud risk management and has authority to drive action.

questions.prompt: Fraud risk is recognised in the organisation's wider risk or governance framework.
questions.controlObjective: Fraud risk is recognised in the organisation's wider risk or governance framework.

questions.prompt: Fraud risks, incidents and control weaknesses are reported to senior leadership or a governance forum on a defined rhythm.
questions.controlObjective: Fraud risks, incidents and control weaknesses are reported to senior leadership or a governance forum on a defined rhythm.

questions.prompt: Management owns fraud-risk decisions and control action.
questions.controlObjective: Management owns fraud-risk decisions and control action.
questions.weightBasis: D1-Q04 V1.1 weight 1.5 divided: 1.0 retained management ownership; 0.5 allocated to D1-Q07 independent assurance.

questions.prompt: Written guidance sets out how fraud should be prevented and detected, and how suspected fraud should be reported and handled.
questions.controlObjective: Written guidance sets out how fraud should be prevented and detected, and how suspected fraud should be reported and handled.

questions.prompt: Leadership receives updates on emerging fraud threats affecting the sector, operating model or customer and supplier environment.
questions.controlObjective: Leadership receives updates on emerging fraud threats affecting the sector, operating model or customer and supplier environment.

questions.prompt: Fraud risk and key controls receive independent review appropriate to the organisation’s size and operating model.
questions.controlObjective: Separate management ownership from independent review by an assurance function, governing body or external specialist where appropriate.
questions.weightBasis: Split from D1-Q04 V1.1 weight 1.5; explicit 0.5 owner-review allocation.

questions.prompt: The organisation periodically reviews its fraud risks and control environment.
questions.controlObjective: The organisation periodically reviews its fraud risks and control environment.

questions.prompt: Fraud incidents or control failures are analysed to understand root causes and control weaknesses.
questions.controlObjective: Fraud incidents or control failures are analysed to understand root causes and control weaknesses.

questions.prompt: Lessons from investigations or incidents are translated into control, process, training or monitoring improvements.
questions.controlObjective: Lessons from investigations or incidents are translated into control, process, training or monitoring improvements.

questions.prompt: Leadership periodically reviews whether key fraud controls remain effective, resourced and fit for purpose.
questions.controlObjective: Leadership periodically reviews whether key fraud controls remain effective, resourced and fit for purpose.

questions.prompt: The organisation has completed a structured fraud risk assessment within the past two years.
questions.controlObjective: The organisation has completed a structured fraud risk assessment within the past two years.

questions.prompt: Fraud risks are mapped to the organisation’s important processes.
questions.controlObjective: Fraud risks are mapped to the organisation’s important processes.

questions.prompt: New systems, channels, products, services or operational changes include fraud-risk review before implementation.
questions.controlObjective: New systems, channels, products, services or operational changes include fraud-risk review before implementation.

questions.prompt: Fraud risks are refreshed when the organisation changes how it operates, serves customers or works with suppliers.
questions.controlObjective: Fraud risks are refreshed when the organisation changes how it operates, serves customers or works with suppliers.

questions.prompt: Fraud risks linked to suppliers, contractors, agents, intermediaries or other third parties have been assessed.
questions.controlObjective: Fraud risks linked to suppliers, contractors, agents, intermediaries or other third parties have been assessed.

questions.prompt: The organisation monitors emerging fraud threats affecting its industry, geography or operating environment.
questions.controlObjective: The organisation monitors emerging fraud threats affecting its industry, geography or operating environment.

questions.prompt: The organisation considers how fraud could occur through misuse of authority, privileged access, approvals, system permissions or operational process gaps.
questions.controlObjective: The organisation considers how fraud could occur through misuse of authority, privileged access, approvals, system permissions or operational process gaps.

questions.prompt: The organisation considers how fraud could occur through customer or user platforms, online forms, WhatsApp journeys, loyalty programmes, service portals or other digital channels where relevant.
questions.controlObjective: The organisation considers how fraud could occur through customer or user platforms, online forms, WhatsApp journeys, loyalty programmes, service portals or other digital channels where relevant.

questions.prompt: High-risk processes have segregation of duties between initiation, approval, processing and reconciliation.
questions.controlObjective: High-risk processes have segregation of duties between initiation, approval, processing and reconciliation.

questions.prompt: Transactions or operational activities above defined risk or value thresholds require independent review or approval.
questions.controlObjective: Transactions or operational activities above defined risk or value thresholds require independent review or approval.

questions.prompt: Supplier onboarding verifies business identity, ownership and initial banking information before approval.
questions.controlObjective: Supplier onboarding verifies business identity, ownership and initial banking information before approval.

questions.prompt: System and data access is granted against current role requirements.
questions.controlObjective: System and data access is granted against current role requirements.
questions.weightBasis: D3-Q04 V1.1 weight 1.5 divided: 1.0 retained access provisioning; 0.5 allocated to D3-Q08 periodic review.

questions.prompt: Refunds, credits, write-offs, stock adjustments, manual journals and overrides receive independent review where used.
questions.controlObjective: Refunds, credits, write-offs, stock adjustments, manual journals and overrides receive independent review where used.

questions.prompt: Operational processes are periodically reviewed to identify control weaknesses or opportunities for manipulation.
questions.controlObjective: Operational processes are periodically reviewed to identify control weaknesses or opportunities for manipulation.

questions.prompt: People in high-risk roles are subject to appropriate oversight, rotation, secondary review or other compensating controls.
questions.controlObjective: People in high-risk roles are subject to appropriate oversight, rotation, secondary review or other compensating controls.

questions.prompt: System and data access is reviewed periodically and removed when no longer required.
questions.controlObjective: Remove inappropriate or obsolete access before it creates an opportunity for misuse.
questions.weightBasis: Split from D3-Q04 V1.1 weight 1.5; explicit 0.5 owner-review allocation.

questions.prompt: Payroll master-file changes and unusual payroll records receive review before payment.
questions.controlObjective: Reduce fraud through fictitious workers, altered payroll records or unauthorised payroll changes.
questions.weightBasis: NEW; explicit 0.5 owner-review weight for payroll integrity gap.

questions.prompt: Physical cash is counted, safeguarded and reconciled by defined people.
questions.controlObjective: Reduce loss and concealment opportunities in physical cash handling.
questions.weightBasis: NEW; explicit 0.5 owner-review weight for physical-cash gap.

questions.prompt: Stock and physical assets are safeguarded and reconciled by defined people.
questions.controlObjective: Reduce loss and concealment opportunities in stock and physical-asset handling.
questions.weightBasis: NEW; explicit 0.5 owner-review weight for physical-asset gap.

questions.prompt: The organisation monitors transactions or operational activity for unusual patterns, anomalies or red flags.
questions.controlObjective: The organisation monitors transactions or operational activity for unusual patterns, anomalies or red flags.

questions.prompt: Exception reporting provides defined alerts for unusual transactions or activities and a documented review process.
questions.controlObjective: Exception reporting provides defined alerts for unusual transactions or activities and a documented review process.

questions.prompt: Analytics, rules, reports or data checks are used to identify suspicious transactions, behaviour or control exceptions.
questions.controlObjective: Analytics, rules, reports or data checks are used to identify suspicious transactions, behaviour or control exceptions.

questions.prompt: Detection controls are updated when new fraud risks, fraud methods or operational changes emerge.
questions.controlObjective: Detection controls are updated when new fraud risks, fraud methods or operational changes emerge.

questions.prompt: Monitoring covers fraud and control misuse by people inside the organisation.
questions.controlObjective: Monitoring covers fraud and control misuse by people inside the organisation.
questions.weightBasis: D4-Q05 V1.1 weight 1.0 divided: 0.5 retained internal monitoring; 0.5 allocated to D4-Q08 external monitoring.

questions.prompt: People responsible for monitoring suspicious activity know when to escalate concerns and have authority to do so.
questions.controlObjective: People responsible for monitoring suspicious activity know when to escalate concerns and have authority to do so.

questions.prompt: Detection controls are periodically reviewed for effectiveness by management, risk, audit or another independent reviewer.
questions.controlObjective: Detection controls are periodically reviewed for effectiveness by management, risk, audit or another independent reviewer.

questions.prompt: Monitoring covers fraud threats from external parties relevant to the organisation.
questions.controlObjective: Detect relevant external fraud threats and counterparty abuse.
questions.weightBasis: Split from D4-Q05 V1.1 weight 1.0; explicit 0.5 owner-review allocation.

questions.prompt: The organisation has a documented process for responding to suspected fraud incidents.
questions.controlObjective: The organisation has a documented process for responding to suspected fraud incidents.

questions.prompt: Roles and decision rights are defined for fraud triage, investigation, escalation and case closure.
questions.construct: triage, investigation, escalation and closure decision rights
questions.controlObjective: Roles and decision rights are defined for fraud triage, investigation, escalation and case closure.

questions.prompt: Fraud investigations follow documented procedures that protect confidentiality and fair treatment and record key facts, decisions and actions.
questions.controlObjective: Fraud investigations follow documented procedures that protect confidentiality and fair treatment and record key facts, decisions and actions.

questions.prompt: Evidence linked to suspected fraud is identified, preserved and handled appropriately.
questions.controlObjective: Evidence linked to suspected fraud is identified, preserved and handled appropriately.

questions.prompt: External specialists are considered when incidents require forensic, legal, cyber or investigative expertise.
questions.controlObjective: External specialists are considered when incidents require forensic, legal, cyber or investigative expertise.

questions.prompt: The organisation provides a confidential or anonymous channel for reporting suspected fraud or misconduct.
questions.controlObjective: The organisation provides a confidential or anonymous channel for reporting suspected fraud or misconduct.

questions.prompt: Employees know how to recognise suspected fraud and use the reporting channel.
questions.controlObjective: Employees know how to recognise suspected fraud and use the reporting channel.

questions.prompt: Reports submitted through the channel are reviewed independently from the people or teams implicated.
questions.controlObjective: Reports submitted through the channel are reviewed independently from the people or teams implicated.

questions.prompt: The organisation clearly communicates that retaliation against whistleblowers or people who raise concerns is prohibited.
questions.controlObjective: The organisation clearly communicates that retaliation against whistleblowers or people who raise concerns is prohibited.

questions.prompt: Relevant external stakeholders have an appropriate way to report suspected fraud or misconduct.
questions.controlObjective: Relevant external stakeholders have an appropriate way to report suspected fraud or misconduct.

questions.prompt: Suppliers, contractors or other third parties are subject to due diligence before being engaged.
questions.controlObjective: Suppliers, contractors or other third parties are subject to due diligence before being engaged.

questions.prompt: Procurement processes include safeguards against collusion, manipulation, bid rigging or favouritism.
questions.controlObjective: Procurement processes include safeguards against collusion, manipulation, bid rigging or favouritism.

questions.prompt: Employees are required to disclose and manage conflicts of interest involving suppliers or third parties.
questions.controlObjective: Employees are required to disclose and manage conflicts of interest involving suppliers or third parties.

questions.prompt: Supplier payments include checks for invoice manipulation, false vendors and supplier bank-detail changes.
questions.controlObjective: Supplier payments include checks for invoice manipulation, false vendors and supplier bank-detail changes.

questions.prompt: High-risk suppliers or third-party relationships are periodically monitored or reviewed.
questions.controlObjective: High-risk suppliers or third-party relationships are periodically monitored or reviewed.

questions.prompt: Procurement or vendor-management activity is subject to oversight or periodic review.
questions.controlObjective: Procurement or vendor-management activity is subject to oversight or periodic review.

questions.prompt: Fraud risks are considered when using agents, brokers, distributors, intermediaries, partners or outsourced service providers where relevant.
questions.controlObjective: Fraud risks are considered when using agents, brokers, distributors, intermediaries, partners or outsourced service providers where relevant.

questions.prompt: The organisation verifies the identity of customers, users, employees, suppliers or counterparties where identity misuse could create fraud loss or harm.
questions.controlObjective: The organisation verifies the identity of customers, users, employees, suppliers or counterparties where identity misuse could create fraud loss or harm.

questions.prompt: The organisation monitors suspicious access, account or transaction behaviour across its relevant systems and digital channels, including through provider reporting where a third party operates the channel.
questions.controlObjective: The organisation monitors suspicious access, account or transaction behaviour across its relevant systems and digital channels, including through provider reporting where a third party operates the channel.

questions.controlObjective: Employees receive training on phishing, social engineering and digital impersonation attempts.

questions.weightBasis: D8-Q04 V1.1 weight 1.5 divided: 1.0 retained sensitive-access restriction; 0.5 allocated to D8-Q09 periodic review.

questions.prompt: Employees and users know how to report suspicious digital activity or account-security concerns.
questions.controlObjective: Employees and users know how to report suspicious digital activity or account-security concerns.

questions.prompt: Emerging digital fraud risks relevant to the organisation's operations or sector are reviewed periodically.
questions.controlObjective: Emerging digital fraud risks relevant to the organisation's operations or sector are reviewed periodically.

questions.prompt: The organisation can detect identity misuse, account takeover or impersonation.
questions.controlObjective: The organisation can detect identity misuse, account takeover or impersonation.
questions.weightBasis: D8-Q08 V1.1 weight 1.5 divided: 1.0 retained identity detection; 0.5 allocated to D8-Q10 investigation/containment.

questions.prompt: Sensitive access and administrator rights are reviewed periodically.
questions.controlObjective: Identify and remove inappropriate privileged or sensitive access.
questions.weightBasis: Split from D8-Q04 V1.1 weight 1.5; explicit 0.5 owner-review allocation.

questions.prompt: The organisation can investigate and contain identity misuse, account takeover or impersonation.
questions.controlObjective: Investigate and contain identity misuse and account compromise.
questions.weightBasis: Split from D8-Q08 V1.1 weight 1.5; explicit 0.5 owner-review allocation.

questions.prompt: Employees receive periodic training or guidance on fraud risks relevant to their roles and the organisation's operating environment.
questions.controlObjective: Employees receive periodic training or guidance on fraud risks relevant to their roles and the organisation's operating environment.

questions.prompt: Fraud awareness is included in employee onboarding or induction.
questions.controlObjective: Fraud awareness is included in employee onboarding or induction.

questions.controlObjective: Fraud awareness uses practical examples or scenarios.
